# garage_buckets (Data Source)

List all Garage buckets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_buckets" "all" {}

output "bucket_ids" {
  value = data.garage_buckets.all.buckets[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
